remarks: Fully renovated 2-bedroom, 1 bath apartment with in-unit laundry. The main level has a spacious living room, kitchen and 2 bedrooms with ample closet space. 2 off-street parking spaces included. Landlord covers all exterior maintenance & trash. So come be part of a beach community at Shippan Point! Steps to West Beach and Brennans Restaurant. Carry your kayak/paddle-board directly to the water! Walking distance to the bus, Close to Downtown and restaurants and Only 5 minutes to the train station. Good credit, income verification, background check, and rental application are required. Tenant pays electric, gas, and internet. Trash and water included.
